== Notes ==
* This boss has a large [[patrol]] path in the northwestern section of the area. His group travels either in a clockwise or counter-clockwise manner, which can make encountering them difficult.

== Trivia ==
* This creature was named by Simon Porter through the 2007 [[Eye of the North Brand the Boss (2007)|Brand The Boss]] contest.
